positive/scripts/deploy.sh:2:34  error  EG003 used-but-undeclared  DEPLOY_TOKEN is read by the code but not declared in any env file, template or schema
  variable: DEPLOY_TOKEN
  why: Nothing documents that DEPLOY_TOKEN must be set, so a new environment or teammate will not provide it and the code reads an empty value at runtime.
  fix: Add `DEPLOY_TOKEN=` to positive/.env.example (read at positive/scripts/deploy.sh:2), then set it in each real env file. If the platform provides it, add DEPLOY_TOKEN to scanner.ignore_variables in .envguard.yaml.
  docs: https://github.com/ardamoustafa1/envguard/blob/main/docs/rules/EG003-used-but-undeclared.md

positive/src/app.js:3:26  info  EG003 used-but-undeclared  OPTIONAL_FLAG is read by the code but not declared in any env file, template or schema
  variable: OPTIONAL_FLAG
  why: The code falls back to a default, so nothing breaks if OPTIONAL_FLAG is unset, but it is invisible to anyone configuring the app and the default may be wrong for production.
  fix: Document it by adding `OPTIONAL_FLAG= # optional` to positive/.env.example (read at positive/src/app.js:3). If you do not want it documented, add OPTIONAL_FLAG to scanner.ignore_variables in .envguard.yaml.
